title: Midnight Sunwatch
text:
🌙 Midnight Sunwatch — October 09, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B7.3)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C3.5 (Peaked October 08, 2026 at 22:44 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 355 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.33)
🚨 NOAA Warning: Geomagnetic K-index of 4 expected

Still watching that M6.7 flare in today's activity history. 💥👀

A bright active region stands out on the Sun today, while the coronagraph view shows no clearly identifiable large outward-moving structure.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
